_comment: DRAFT per-apps-PR gold for scripts/triage_nuttx_prs.py apps (prompt docs/nuttx_apps_triage.md); awaiting review.

Partial: it lists what is known, not every valid pair. Built from triage/nuttx_gold.json, triage/nuttx_reviewed/, docs/nuttx_bad_prs.md, the checked-in instances in docker/instances/, the link pool (candidates/nuttx/full_history_pairs_real.jsonl) and PR titles/diffs on GitHub, plus the validated apps 3790 -> kernel 20112 run (Scholar ARM64: fails on 221a4b2e4c, passes on 5a209a853e, apps 73a9c9a697, sim:nsh + ostest + CONFIG_SCHED_WORKQUEUE=y, assertion wqueue.c:773).
apps 3785 is not scored: it changes testing/drivers/, not testing/ostest/, so it is outside the 189-PR population. kernel 20091 has no apps PR.

Pass bar: every case correct on 3 consecutive runs. Blind runs (--blind) take the cases with a sim:nsh must_find, hide their explicit kernel links and commit hashes, and are scored separately: tracked, not part of the bar.

_schema.cases: apps-<N>: one entry per scored apps PR. Apps PRs not listed are not scored.
_schema.kind: The expected kind, or a list of acceptable kinds: kernel_test, test_only, apps_fix, qemu_only.
_schema.must_find: Known valid pairs. Each kernel_pr must be proposed at high or medium; when given, platform (sim:nsh, or qemu meaning any qemu-<board>:<config>) and tag must match. Missing one is an error.
_schema.must_not_propose: Known wrong pairs. Proposing one at high or medium is an error; low is allowed.
_schema.unknown: Any other kernel PR proposed at high or medium is unknown: not penalized, listed in the scorecard for validation.
_schema.needs_review: Validation results for a person to settle (from gold-promote): failed validations are never added to must_not_propose automatically, since a pair can fail for config or runner reasons. Not scored.

must_find.evidence: Validated pair (docker/instances/nuttx__nuttx-8832); apps body: 'An ostest for apache/nuttx#8832', 'Without #8832, this would fail'.

apps-1665.notes: kernel 8321 (wqueue semcount fix in kwork_cancel.c, named in the apps body as a state the test tries to trigger) is left unknown: it may be a second valid pair. REVIEW.

must_find.evidence: Validated pair (docker/instances/nuttx__nuttx-8885); compile_error: sigset_t becomes an array, ostest needs SIGSET_FMT/SIGSET_ELEM. Apps title: 'Changes to apps needed by nuttx PR 8885'.

must_not_propose.why: 'boards: Fix broken defconfigs' (10 board defconfigs); linked only by a kernel comment.

must_find.evidence: Validated pair (docker/instances/nuttx__nuttx-9923): sigprocmask/pthread_sigmask must drop SIGKILL and SIGSTOP.

must_not_propose.why: 'Fix cmake-format wrong execution order' (tools/checkpatch.sh only); linked only by an apps comment.

must_find.evidence: Validated pair (docker/instances/nuttx__nuttx-11898): pthread_join on a detached thread must return EINVAL, not ESRCH. Tag is a judgment call: the fix comes with a join refactor. REVIEW.
Validated pair (docker/instances/nuttx__nuttx-12802): compile_error, new nxevent API, needs CONFIG_SCHED_EVENTS=y.
Validated pair (docker/instances/nuttx__nuttx-14152): longjmp(buf, 0) must make setjmp return 1.

Validated on Scholar ARM64: fails on kernel 221a4b2e4c, passes on 5a209a853e (the merge of #20112), apps 73a9c9a697, sim:nsh + ostest + CONFIG_SCHED_WORKQUEUE=y, assertion wqueue.c:773. The apps PR cites the kernel only by the short hash 5a209a853e (body and commit message).

must_not_propose.why: imxrt118x board port; only said 'CI broken, rebase to get apps#3790'.
ESP32 I2C pin attribute fix; CI note only.
ESP32 I2C timeout fix; CI note only.
TC74 sensor driver; CI note only.

must_find.evidence: SMP call API: up_send_smp_call is implemented only for arm64; validator run on sim:nsh cannot link the fixed kernel (docs/nuttx_bad_prs.md). Lead: qemu-armv8a:nsh_smp (triage/nuttx_qemu_leads.jsonl).

must_not_propose.why: Kconfig follow-up (PTHREAD_CLEANUP -> PTHREAD_CLEANUP_STACKSIZE guards), no new assertion; the validator run was ambiguous because the old kernel lacks the new symbol, so the test compiles out and cannot fail. A low lead is fine. REVIEW the kind.

The kernel PR exposed a compile error that the apps PR fixes in the test sources; nothing is left for a kernel task. The validator run was ambiguous (CONFIG_SCHED_SPORADIC off on sim:nsh). A low lead is fine.

apps-3676.notes: Gates the perf test to flat builds to fix a link failure in protected/kernel builds (docs/nuttx_bad_prs.md). Either kind is accepted. REVIEW.

apps-3767.notes: Worker stack 2048 -> STACKSIZE so the wqueue test runs on intel64 (docs/nuttx_bad_prs.md). Either kind is accepted. REVIEW.
